mentions.name: Flip7 Battle
mentions.description: This app manages daily scores for the Flip7 card game and turns family play into weekly and monthly competitions with leaderboards. It is currently available on the Apple App Store.
mentions.audience: Family members who play the Flip7 card game
mentions.source_excerpt: Created an app to make it more fun and engaging by creating an app to manage the daily score and to make it a weekly, monthly competition for leaderboard.

evidence.value: Created an app to make it more fun and engaging by creating an app to manage the daily score and to make it a weekly, monthly competition for leaderboard.
